name: omnis-watchtower
description: Mission control for your coding agents, with a supply-chain tripwire that checks every npm and PyPI install before it runs.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce refuses dangerous installs; warn-only reports them but never refuses.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Refuse installs if Watchtower itself faults while checking (default: allow with a loud warning).

autoOpen.title: Auto-open
autoOpen.description: Open the mission-control pane at session start when the terminal is at least 144 columns wide.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Static effects, at most 4 frames per second.

sentinelModel.title: Sentinel model
sentinelModel.description: Model the Sentinel investigator runs on.

sentinelTimeoutSec.title: Sentinel timeout (seconds)
sentinelTimeoutSec.description: How long a held package waits for a verdict before it is refused (60 to 900).

privateAllowlist.title: Private package patterns
privateAllowlist.description: Comma-separated globs for private packages that are never checked against public registries, e.g. @acme/*, acme-*.
